subject: Evidence request: EU data residency, retention & deletion controls
messages:
From: Michael Sullivan <m.sullivan@acme-corp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, AuditCorp SOC Team <soc-team@auditcorp.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 16:12:00 +00:00
Subject: Evidence request: EU data residency, retention & deletion controls

Hi Mina,

AuditCorp is kicking off our ISO/SOC evidence collection for Acme's use of Redwood. Can you provide the following artifacts for Acme (EU tenants) by EOD 2025-09-18 if possible: 

- Current data residency map for EU customers (what region/cluster each tenant is stored in)
- The retention policy that governs customer data (server logs, user content, embeddings) and configuration screenshots showing effective retention windows for Acme's tenant
- Deletion job logs for the last six months (Mar–Aug 2025) showing tenant-level deletion runs and success/failure counts
- Evidence of irreversible deletion (s3/object lifecycle details or KMS key status) for sample deletion events
- KMS rotation and key management proof tied to those objects/regions

If any of these require a redaction or specific export process, let me know and we can accept sample slices and attestation. Also let me know if you prefer a DocuSign attestation instead of raw logs.

Thanks,
Michael Sullivan
Security & Compliance, Acme Corp

--
AuditCorp SOC Team (cc) will review once you provide the bundle.

- Marissa: residency mapping + retention policy and screenshots showing tenant config (dashboard or API export)

Thanks — Mina

Mina — I pulled the residency map and retention policy. Attaching: redwood_retention_policy_v2.1.pdf and eu-residency-mapping-2025-08.csv (small mapping for Acme's tenant IDs). Summary:

- redwood_retention_policy_v2.1.pdf: covers standard retention defaults and override hierarchy (system default -> org-level -> tenant-level). Policy explicitly states short-term logs (30 days) vs long-term user content (90/365 windows configurable).
- eu-residency-mapping-2025-08.csv: columns tenant_id, logical_region, physical_cluster, storage_backend. Acme's EU tenants are pinned to eu-west-1 clusters with cross-region backups disabled.

I also exported the UI view showing Acme's effective retention settings (screenshot saved as attachment in Drive). I redacted tenant names and left tenant IDs in the CSV.

Let me know if you want an API export instead of the CSV; aditya can run that if needed.

Attachments: redwood_retention_policy_v2.1.pdf (policy doc), eu-residency-mapping-2025-08.csv (mapping), drive link in the thread.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: deletion job logs + irreversible deletion proof

Mina / team — I extracted the deletion job logs for Mar–Aug 2025 and compiled a summary log: deletion_runs_2025-03_to_2025-08.log (attached). Notes and clarifications: 

- Deletion pipeline: job name tenant-delete-v2 runs nightly per-region; logs include tenant_id, run_id, objects_queued, objects_deleted, errors. I included three sample run slices for Acme tenant IDs with full event traces (timestamps + object placeholders).
- Irreversible deletion: for customer content stored in S3-backed object store with KMS encryption, we provide a multi-step proof: a) object deletion event in the log; b) lifecycle tombstone and S3 delete-marker entries; c) KMS key status showing no ability to decrypt archived snapshots (screenshot / PDF). For samples where data was permanently removed, we included the S3 object keys as hashed values (sha256) to avoid leaking PII.
- KMS rotation: included kms-rotation-report-2025Q2.pdf showing rotation timestamps and key IDs used by EU clusters. We rotate CMKs quarterly and maintain IAM role audit trails.

A couple of questions for AuditCorp: is an attestation (DocuSign) sufficient in lieu of full log export for the irreversible deletion proof, or do you need the raw tombstone entries? We can provide redacted raw entries + attestation.

Attachment stubs: deletion_runs_2025-03_to_2025-08.log, kms-rotation-report-2025Q2.pdf

—Neha
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

3) Supporting notes and attestations
